headlines.title: House votes to block motion to impeach Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth
headlines.description: The Republican-led House narrowly rejected a push to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over how he has carried out the war in Iran and other military hostilities in Yemen, Venezuela and the Caribbean. NBC News' Sahil Kapur and Courtney Kube discuss the tactic the GOP used to send the motion to the House Judiciary Committee and how Hegseth disputed the impeachment articles.

headlines.title: Measles cases explode amid declining vaccination rates
headlines.description: NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin traveled to Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, which is the epicenter of a deadly measles outbreak. The investigative report for the NBC News series “The Vaccine Divide” finds 75% of U.S. counties have vaccination rates that are now below the level needed for herd immunity.

headlines.title: What are childhood vaccination rates in your community and schools?
headlines.description: This is part of The Vaccine Divide, an updated data investigation into America potentially losing its measles-free status as the deadly virus roars back and childhood vaccine defenses continue to crack and crumble.

headlines.title: Behind the data: How NBC News tracked the decline in childhood vaccinations
headlines.description: How an NBC News data investigation tracked vaccination and school exemption rates across thousands of counties in the U.S.

headlines.title: Bernie Sanders says he won’t support Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader
headlines.description: Sens. Sanders and Elissa Slotkin called for new leadership, but neither proposed an alternative. Sen. Chris Van Hollen of Maryland is considering challenging Schumer.

headlines.title: GOP Rep. María Elvira Salazar wins re-election in Florida after clashing with Trump
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Salazar defeated her Democratic opponent in a heavily Hispanic, Miami-based district that Trump carried by 15 points in 2024.

headlines.title: U.S. charges 3 men with plotting multiple terror attacks, including planned attack against U.K. airbase
headlines.description: One of the men helped direct the planned attack against the air base while he was in a U.S. prison, according to a Justice Department indictment.

headlines.title: Senior U.S. Army soldier arrested in U.K. on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence
headlines.description: The 41-year-old man was arrested “as part of an investigation by Counter Terrorism Policing” near the ⁠city of Gloucester, ​in the west ⁠of England, British police said.

headlines.title: Russia's last major independent newspaper shuts down citing Kremlin assault on free press
headlines.description: Novaya Gazeta, renowned for uncovering human rights abuses and corruption through fierce reporting, closes its doors after more than three decades. The news outlet says it's shutting down due to government pressure from the Kremlin. NBC News' Matt Bodner reports.

headlines.title: Nvidia names outside council for investigation into CEO’s affair
headlines.description: Nvidia has named Joon Kim, a former acting U.S. Attorney, to head the investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with a woman U.S. intelligence agencies believe to be a Chinese spy. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: Call her candid: Sofia Franklyn’s memoir details Alex Cooper fallout
headlines.description: “Daddy Issues” is a tell-all from Franklyn’s side about the end of her business relationship and friendship with Cooper, who went on to helm “Call Her Daddy” solo.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.
